source.title: New Delhi metallo-β-lactamase-1 in Enterobacteriaceae: emerging resistance

extraction_metadata.scope_note: This source is a narrative review, not primary literature. Quantitative findings from cited studies are retained as secondary reports and tagged secondary_reported_result. Bibliographic entries are not atomized.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review searched PubMed for the term "NDM-1" for scientific articles published through October 2010.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We searched PubMed using the term “NDM-1” for all relevant scientific articles published up to and including October 2010.

atoms.canonical_statement: The PubMed search identified 23 research articles; the authors used 4 and excluded 19 because they lacked new information or were not available in English.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Twenty-three research articles were identified... Four of these articles were used in this review, and 19 articles were excluded

atoms.canonical_statement: At least two authors reviewed each included article; the review also used Google News searches and personal communication with relevant experts.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Each of the included articles was reviewed by at least two of the authors. A Google News search... was also conducted.

atoms.canonical_statement: NDM-1 was described as a mobile-element-associated carbapenemase that conferred resistance to all β-lactam antibiotics available in Canada at the time of publication.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: NDM-1, which is found on mobile genetic elements and confers resistance to all β-lactam antibiotics available in Canada.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review states that mobile genetic elements carrying NDM-1 typically also carried resistance genes affecting fluoroquinolones, aminoglycosides, and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: These mobile genetic elements... typically carry genes that confer resistance to fluoroquinolones, aminoglycosides and trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports that NDM-1 was first described in 2009 in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolated in Sweden from a patient who had previously received medical care in New Delhi.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: It was first described in 2009 in K. pneumoniae isolated from a patient... who had previously received medical care in New Delhi.

atoms.canonical_statement: By the end of 2009, the review reports NDM-1-positive Escherichia coli or Klebsiella isolates in at least 29 UK patients; 17 had traveled to the Indian subcontinent.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: By the end of 2009... identified in at least 29 patients... Seventeen of the 29 patients had travelled to the Indian subcontinent

population.label: UK patients with reported NDM-1-positive E. coli or Klebsiella isolates

quantitative_result.original_result_text: Seventeen of the 29 patients had travelled to the Indian subcontinent

atoms.canonical_statement: Among the same 29 UK patients, the review reports that 14 had received medical care in the Indian subcontinent.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: and 14 of them had received medical care while there.

population.label: UK patients with reported NDM-1-positive E. coli or Klebsiella isolates

concept.text: Prior medical care in the Indian subcontinent

quantitative_result.original_result_text: 14 of them had received medical care while there

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports that all 26 NDM-1 isolates from Haryana had an indistinguishable genetic fingerprint, which the authors interpreted as evidence of dissemination of a single epidemic strain.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: all 26 isolates from the area of Haryana had an indistinguishable genetic fingerprint, which suggests the dissemination of a single epidemic strain.

atoms.canonical_statement: At a tertiary care center in Mumbai, 22 of 24 carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae isolates collected from August through November 2009 produced NDM-1.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: of the 24 carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae species isolated... between August and November 2009, 22 produced the NDM-1 enzyme.

population.label: Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae isolates at a Mumbai tertiary care center

quantitative_result.original_result_text: 24 carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae... 22 produced the NDM-1 enzyme

atoms.canonical_statement: The review states that the scale of NDM-1 in the Indian subcontinent could not be evaluated well because actual prevalence data were unavailable.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: It is difficult to evaluate the scope of the problem in the Indian subcontinent owing to the lack of availability of actual prevalence data on NDM-1.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports that international travel was a risk factor for acquisition of resistant Enterobacteriaceae, with the cited Calgary surveillance study finding the highest risk among travelers to India, the Middle East, and Africa.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: overseas travel significantly increased the risk... and that the risk was highest among travellers to India, the Middle East and Africa.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports that one study found most metallo-β-lactamase-mediated carbapenem resistance in Enterobacteriaceae was detected by the Vitek 2, MicroScan WalkAway, and Phoenix automated susceptibility platforms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: one study showed that most of the carbapenem resistance mediated by metallo-β-lactamase in Enterobacteriaceae was detected using... Vitek 2, MicroScan WalkAway and Phoenix.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review states that molecular confirmation was required to determine whether phenotypic carbapenem resistance was caused by NDM-1, another carbapenemase, or alternate mechanisms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Actual characterization of the resistance mechanism... requires molecular confirmation.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review recommends considering NDM-1 in patients with carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae who had received medical care in India or Pakistan and specifically asking about that exposure.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Clinicians should be aware of the possibility... in patients who have received medical care in India or Pakistan and should specifically ask about this risk factor

atoms.canonical_statement: At publication, the review described different screening positions across guidelines: US guidance did not recommend pre-emptive colonization screening, Canadian guidance proposed situation-specific screening, and European guidance considered active screening of at-risk patients essential.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: American guidelines do not recommend pre-emptive screening... Canadian guidelines propose that screening should be specific... European guidelines state that active screening... is essential.

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports attributable case-fatality rates as high as 50% for bacteremia caused by carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella species.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The attributable case-fatality rate for bacteremias caused by carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella species is reportedly as high as 50%.

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 37 British NDM-1 isolates, the review reports 89% colistin susceptibility, with MIC50 0.5 mg/L and MIC90 8 mg/L.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 37 British isolates harbouring NDM-1 had a 50% minimum inhibitory concentration of 0.5 mg/L and a 90%... 8 mg/L for colistin (i.e., 89% susceptible)

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 37 British NDM-1 isolates, the review reports 65% tigecycline susceptibility, with MIC50 1 mg/L and MIC90 4 mg/L.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: a 50% minimum inhibitory concentration of 1 mg/L and a 90% minimum inhibitory concentration of 4 mg/L for tigecycline (i.e., 65% susceptible).

atoms.canonical_statement: The review states that recent colistin efficacy and safety evidence consisted only of retrospective case reports and case series, often with substantial comorbidity and sample sizes too small to assess efficacy well.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Recent reports regarding the efficacy and safety of colistin include only retrospective case reports and case series... most case series were too small to fully assess the efficacy of therapy.

atoms.canonical_statement: In one Greek hospital, 12 patients with carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae infection who received a colistin-containing regimen had a reported attributable mortality rate of 18.8%.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 12 patients infected with carbapenemase-producing K. pneumoniae who were given a colistin-containing regimen had an attributable mortality rate of 18.8%.

population.label: Patients with carbapenemase-producing K. pneumoniae infection at one Greek hospital

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports polymyxin resistance in up to 25% of multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates in New York City, including carbapenem-resistant strains.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: up to 25% of isolates of multidrug-resistant strains of K. pneumoniae in New York City... were resistant to polymyxins.

population.label: Multidrug-resistant K. pneumoniae isolates in New York City

quantitative_result.original_result_text: up to 25%... were resistant to polymyxins

atoms.canonical_statement: The review describes the then-recommended tigecycline regimen as a 100 mg intravenous loading dose followed by 50 mg every 12 hours.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The recommended regimen for tigecycline is an initial dose of 100 mg intravenously, followed by 50 mg every 12 hours.

exposures.details: Loading dose 100 mg IV, then 50 mg every 12 hours

atoms.canonical_statement: The review states that small clinical studies of tigecycline in carbapenem-resistant or multidrug-resistant Enterobacteriaceae infections reported favorable outcomes in almost 70% of patients.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Clinical studies report favourable outcomes in almost 70% of patients (although the sample population was small)

atoms.canonical_statement: The review notes that the FDA had added a warning about increased mortality with tigecycline compared with other antibiotics used for similar infections.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the US Food and Drug Administration updated sections of the tigecycline drug label to include information regarding increased risk of death

atoms.canonical_statement: The review reports one study suggesting in vitro synergy between colistin and tigecycline against a similar carbapenemase-producing organism.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: One study suggested that colistin and tigecycline acted synergistically against a similar carbapenemase.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors conclude that the lack of proven effective therapy for NDM-1-producing bacteria and other carbapenem-resistant organisms created a need for new antimicrobial agents.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The lack of proven effective therapies emphasizes the need for new agents for the treatment of infections caused by NDM-1–producing bacteria

atoms.canonical_statement: For the hypothetical case, the authors proposed six weeks of colistin plus tigecycline with removal of prosthetic hardware and close renal-function monitoring because of diabetes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A combination of colistin and tigecycline for 6 weeks, with removal of the prosthetic hardware, would be an appropriate treatment regimen
